notes.raw:
Phase changes: 720 K, α - β transition point of Ca; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.220$ kcal/mol. 1112 K, melting point of Ca; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.040$ kcal/mol. 1757 K, boiling point of Ca; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 36.626$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2500 K: $Cp^{0} = 6.197 + 3.232 \times 10^{-3} T + 1.029 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 6.197 \times 10^{-3} T + 1.616 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 1.029 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 1.646$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-720 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 15.077 - 1.806 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.114 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 76.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 15.077 + 1.806 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} + 1.114 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 38.025 \text{T}^{-1} - 31.556 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
720-1112 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 13.336 + 2.133 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 3.486 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 137.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 13.336 - 2.133 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} + 3.486 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 68.525 \text{T}^{-1} - 4.877 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1112-1757 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 13.088 - 4.975 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.456 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 137.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 13.088 + 4.975 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 1.456 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 68.525 \text{T}^{-1} - 49.007 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1757-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -27.083 - 2.945 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.449 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 137.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -27.083 + 2.945 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 1.449 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 68.525 \text{T}^{-1} - 10.989 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated some molecular constants.
